Explicit implementation revision; preserve every accepted requirement, the query-only public interface, actual per-product visits, workbook writing and unconditional Browser cleanup. The current proposal cannot be approved. Correct all diagnosed requires: conditions must be boolean TaskValues, explicit typed predicates or accessible present(task); references to strings, objects and arrays are not conditions. Preserve real completeness, blocker and nullable-value guards rather than replacing them with true. open_search currently JSON-encodes a fixed URL fragment and never binds query. Actually search using query, preferably by opening the site, observing a fill-compatible field and calling the discovered fill operation with submit=true; do not invent a search URL or selector. Use observed references from the current snapshot for interactions, explicit activate intent for a control, and fresh observation after any interaction before subsequent reference use. Cookie-information links are not activation controls.

The proposal sends raw complete snapshots straight to interpretation and has no independent extraction. Add explicit extract-mode compaction with each over the declared snapshot pages (each original page exposes records). Process all complete bounded pages into compact business candidates/facts, retaining exact observed references, actions and grouping only where needed for the subsequent decision. Global interpretation consumes only compact relevant facts. Keep complete acquisition checks tied to producer metadata before extraction. Do the same for search-result links and product details; no large raw snapshot goes directly to a global transform. Independent extraction returns exactly one result per source page with nested candidates/facts, not a synthesized global decision. Preserve complete coverage, order and exact source values. Runtime scripts and technical item paths are not TaskPlan fields.

Conditional alternatives must project matching explicit consumer-facing ports with identical types/nullability/requiredness instead of differently shaped post_cookie_state objects. Nullable references need their own not_equal(null) guard on the consuming path; a state enum/boolean alone is insufficient. References from before an interaction cannot be reused afterwards. Preserve only necessary global decisions on compact observations, explicit limitation/CAPTCHA handling, first-ten selection in observed order, a real sequential product visit loop and extraction from each visited result, and actual document_write before publishing its returned filePath. No fabricated fallback product rows or success after incomplete observations. Keep scope dependencies local and expose inner values through matching declared exports. Retain the existing operation contracts and limits; do not request new caller inputs or permissions.
